column1: # wackerbarth1717 key K1715: Saxon system S1, letter of 20 October 1715 (Dresden, HStA 10026 Loc. 00712/05). CC BY 4.0
# (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, 2026; Claude Opus 5.5 agents). Learnt ONLY from views 0388-0390 of the same volume (extract of the
# countess's letter of 5 Oct. 1715 and its sequel, glossed between the lines at the time): pairs number=value aligned on the
# glosses, values marked "?" excluded, majority vote per number; 57 numbers, 934 pairs, no contradiction (frozen script build_key).
# Frozen BEFORE the single measurement: SHA-256 69bda7318c98fc59c6bdfd018869682b87ec281e91c0c4bb53f047e492a268eb (the lines below,
# from "# nombre" on, are the frozen file byte for byte except its first comment line, which said "PRIVÉE (InC)").
# Same system as S1 of 1717 (key.tsv section A): 47 of the 50 numbers common to both keys agree (77 s/ss, 97 la/m, 187 differ).
# For the reading, numbers absent from K1715 took their S1/1717 value (counted PROBABLE): e.g. 72 = ch, 63 ff, 65 tt, 76 st;
# values deduced in this letter (96 = le, 85 = st, 70 = x, 64 = c, 284 = comte, 75 = s) are also only probable. See s15_reading.md.
